description: This file defines the SampleRepository class, which provides sample data for a media application, including images for various genres, a featured item, and methods to retrieve tabs, featured content, genre rows, and find media items by ID.

classes.name: SampleRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing sample media data for the application.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns a list of tab items for the application's navigation.

methods.name: genreRows
methods.description: Returns a list of genre rows, each containing a list of media items.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds and returns a MediaItem by its ID, searching through genre rows and the featured item.
